notes: Authored deterministic fixture. The proposal is reasonable and would be safe to approve, but it never says how anyone would confirm the change worked — the gate warns rather than blocks, and the decision stays with the human. This is not model output.

proposal.summary: De-prefer the flapping primary transit path on agg-rtr-01 by raising its route metric above the standby path, so traffic stops re-converging while the carrier works the circuit.

diagnosis.likelyCause: The primary transit circuit is unstable at the carrier edge; each flap forces re-convergence on agg-rtr-01, which the access layer sees as brief loss windows. The standby path has been stable for two weeks with ample headroom.
assumptions: The standby transit circuit can carry the full branch aggregate at 4% current utilization
The carrier maintenance case covers the flapping primary circuit and is still open

operations.reason: Raise the primary transit metric above the standby (90) so the stable path is preferred until the carrier circuit is repaired

rollbackOperations.reason: Restore the original primary transit metric once the circuit is stable

verificationSteps.description: Confirm the standby transit path is up and its utilization leaves headroom for the branch aggregate
